verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own API as a way to programmatically extract information (vanta-docs-24) and to list documents, policies, evidence, controls, tests, and audit data (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-7, vanta-docs-29, vanta-docs-58), which counts as a first-party data-extraction path. There is no documented bulk or one-click export, no claim of completeness, and no stated open file formats, so leaving would mean building extraction on top of the API. missing for 10: dedicated full-account export, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON bundles), coverage guarantee for all data types, offboarding/data-portability docs, independent corroboration.
